claims.text: Mistral's Aug 20 post describes Agentic Search as a multi-step retrieval loop (find, inspect, verify) over existing indexes with five tools: search, open, navigate, read, grep.
The post states the model inspects findings, refines searches, opens documents, navigates sections, and reads source material before answering, reducing turns/token use/latency.
The post reports evaluation on FinanceBench and OfficeQA Pro with default stack settings.
